….President has won enemies of democracy – Yari By Omeiza Ajayi ABUJA: President Bola Tinubu has vowed to defeat those he described as enemies of Nigeria’s unity and stability, telling supporters at his ruling All Progressives Congress APC presidential campaign rally in Dutse, the Jigawa State capital, that the fight against insecurity will be won.
